dreamteamer.title: Proofs
dreamteamer.description: Behaviour proofs: `dt prove` runs a `proofs/` source against a skill, command, command-binding or module script and answers with an exit code — 0 pass · 1 fail · 3 unavailable · 4 no-fixture · 5 pending · 6 vacuous — and keeps the evidence per machine. Adds the `proofs` source kind (with `proofs/fixtures/` as the records a `writes` proof runs against), the `proofs` collection, an analysis that validates every proof at compile, and the `proving-artifacts` skill. A `writes` proof runs in a throwaway checkout this module creates and removes itself; it needs no other module.
